t: The Cate PIR outdoor wall light combines a heritage-inspired, hand-painted design with practical security. Designed to elevate any exterior and operates as a refined alternative to a standard lantern light. Features toughened glass and is best complemented with an LED filament bulb for an ambient glow (bulb required). Fitted with a discreet PIR sensor to automatically activate when movement is detected. Ideal for lighting pathways, boosting security and improving visibility after dark. Adjustable time and lux settings allow for customised operation, while a manual override keeps the light on when required. Designed for year-round use and built from heavy-duty aluminium. IP44 rated.
